daily_prep_about_1_min: Circles; slow rocks on hands and knees
builder_2x_week: Plank on hands, shifting weight forward and back, 20 to 30 s
get_checked_if: Numbness or tingling that stays; swelling; pain on any weight-bearing

daily_prep_about_1_min: Open and close fists; slow bends and straightens
builder_2x_week: Slow 4-second lowering on rows and push-ups; 20 s hold mid-range
get_checked_if: Sharp pain that worsens each session; locking; swelling

builder_2x_week: Scapular push-ups and hanging shoulder shrugs, 2 x 8
get_checked_if: Night pain; arm weakness; catching or giving way

daily_prep_about_1_min: Chin tucks; extension over a chair back
builder_2x_week: Prone Y-T-W raises on the floor, 2 x 8 each
get_checked_if: Pain with arm numbness; dizziness or headache with training

builder_2x_week: Bird dog, side plank, and a small curl-up, 2 sets each
get_checked_if: Leg numbness or weakness; loss of bladder or bowel control (emergency); pain after a fall

builder_2x_week: Single-leg bridge; split squat with a pause at the bottom
get_checked_if: Groin pain with clicking or locking; night pain

daily_prep_about_1_min: Slow box squat; wall tibialis raises
builder_2x_week: Box squat with 3-second lowering; wall sit 30 to 45 s
get_checked_if: Swelling; locking; giving way; pain on stairs that keeps worsening

builder_2x_week: Single-leg calf raise, 3-second lowering; one-leg balance 30 s
get_checked_if: Cannot bear weight after a twist; sharp heel or Achilles pain that worsens
